g.text: Teaching a Simulated F-16 to Fly
A ﬂight simulator built from the physics up, then PPO agents that learn to ﬂy it and beat its autopilot.
· the jetsim package, validated by 596 tests
commands g, roll rate, throttle via ﬂy-by-wire, or moves the control surfaces directly
100 Hz physics · 50 Hz FBW · 10 Hz agent
